<function name="SendOmit" parent="net" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
		Sends the current message (see <page>net.Start</page>) to all except the player or players specified.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	
	<args name="Ommit Single Player">
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player to **NOT** send the message to.</arg>
	</args>
	<args name="Ommit Multiple Players">
		<arg name="plys" type="table<Player>">A table of players to **NOT** send the message to.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
